answer: Make each new agent identity post a refundable stake that is locked for 30 days, and let its voting weight grow with stake-time, not headcount. An attacker splitting funds across 100 fake agents gets the same weight as one agent, while paying 100 registration fees. Slashing hits any stake that vouches for a flagged cluster, so a spiral of mutual endorsements drags every member toward its nadir. Auditors search the atlas of vouch edges for dense, closed loops and earn a share of slashed stake.
